abstract: A case of a primary choriocarcinoma of the stomach is reported together with review of 44 cases in the Japanese literature. The patient, a 79-year-old male complaining of severe anemia, was admitted to hospital. As a result of a gastric endoscopy, a carcinoma was diagnosed and a laparotomy was performed. Because of an extensive metastasis, however, the surgery was limited to a palliative proximal gastrectomy. Pathologically, the tumor was a choriocarcinoma, and the HCG in the blood was slightly elevated. Immunohistologically, however, no HCG was detected. Although most cases reported in Japan support the theory of differentiations in gastric carcinomas, this choriocarcinoma suggests a separate type of differentiation in both the function and the morphology or a morphological mimicking.
abstract_ja: 79歳男性が重度の貧血を主訴に入院した原発性胃絨毛癌の症例を報告し、日本の文献で報告された44例のレビューを併せて示す。胃内視鏡検査で癌と診断され開腹術が行われたが、広範な転移のため手術は近位胃切除による姑息的切除にとどめられた。病理学的に腫瘍は絨毛癌であり、血中hCGはわずかに上昇していた。しかし免疫組織学的には、腫瘍内にhCGは検出されなかった。日本で報告された胃癌の多くは分化説を支持するが、本症例は機能と形態の両面で別種の分化、あるいは形態的な模倣を示唆する。
